variants.title: A · 정돈된 기술기업형
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE original high-fidelity desktop homepage design proposal for JW BUSINESS 01, a premium Korean industrial equipment company theme. Portrait canvas 1536 x 2304 or similar tall aspect. Flat straight-on website screenshot, edge to edge, no browser chrome, no device frame, no annotations outside website. Show a coherent homepage from header through compact footer. All photographs must be newly generated realistic industrial imagery, no real corporate logos, no watermarks. This is an original design, not a reproduction of a referenced website.
Identical fictional demo business and content across alternatives:
Brand wordmark "HANGYEOL TECH", small Korean "한결테크". Header navigation "회사소개  사업소개  제품소개  납품사례  고객지원" and CTA "견적 문의".
Hero exact Korean headline "현장에 맞는 설비,\n정확한 도입의 시작." supporting line "설비 선정부터 설치와 유지관리까지 함께합니다." CTA "제품 살펴보기" secondary text "도입 사례 보기".
Services "설비 공급" "자동화 구성" "설치·유지관리".
Products: aluminum modular conveyor with dark belt "모듈형 벨트 컨베이어" model "HC-200"; compact metal machine-vision inspection unit "비전 검사 유닛" model "HV-30"; aluminum industrial workbench "조립형 작업대" model "HW-1200". Use those consistent products with natural real-looking photography and plausible engineering geometry.
Case study "포장 공정 이송라인 구축", believable clean factory installation photo. Technical document "컨베이어 설치 전 확인사항". Final CTA "도입할 설비를 함께 검토합니다." button "견적 문의". Footer small "가상 기업 · 테마 디자인 시안". No made-up certification, awards, statistics, client logos, prices or contacts. Korean typography must be clear and professionally typeset, no lorem ipsum. Use generous typography and short text instead of microscopic paragraphs. Do not add a chat bubble, badge soup or decorative dashboard. Product grids are okay; editorial sections should not all be boxed cards. This is a desktop design image, not actual HTML.
Visual direction A: PRECISION CORPORATE. Bright white #FFFFFF, ink navy #172B3A, restrained deep blue #185ADB accent. Calm precise premium engineering publication. White spacious 80px header. Hero is one edge-to-edge 620px composition: a natural pale industrial hall with an aluminum conveyor concentrated on the RIGHT, clear uncluttered bright LEFT area carrying huge dark Korean headline and solid blue CTA. Photography seamlessly fills the hero; no split panels. Large margins, rigorous baseline alignment, thin rules, almost square button corners. After hero: small "OUR SOLUTIONS" eyebrow and horizontal service list with 01/02/03, concise Korean labels. Then prominent "현장에 맞는 제품" heading and three equal borderless product photography columns with model numbers. Then asymmetrical case-study section, large factory photo on left, title and short statement on right. Then one tidy technical-document row and a navy full-width inquiry band with white type. Minimal white footer. Composition must balance strong company identity, real products and case proof. Clear beautifully set Hangul. Do not create generic SaaS UI.

Visual direction C: PRODUCT CATALOG. White #FFFFFF, soft cool gray #F1F4F6, graphite #20262D, restrained cobalt #2459D3. Practical premium B2B engineering catalog with exceptionally clear information hierarchy, not a consumer marketplace. White wordmark/navigation header then an elegant broad search field with placeholder "제품명 또는 모델명을 검색하세요".
